Oman’s O-Green targets 200MW of data center capacity by 2028

A new state-backed renewable energy company in Oman is developing AI-ready data centers across the sultanate, as well as Spain and other European markets. O-Green is targeting more than 200MW to be ready for service by 2028, the company said on LinkedIn. – Getty Images Founded last year to accelerat
